name: registro-horario-monorepo
description: Sistema de registro horario con Node.js + Express + React

scripts.install: cd app/back && npm install && cd ../front && npm install && cd ../admin && npm install && cd ../kiosk && npm install
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:back" "npm run dev:front" "npm run dev:admin" "npm run dev:kiosk"
scripts.dev:secure: concurrently "npm run dev:back" "npm run dev:admin" "npm run dev:kiosk"
scripts.build: npm run build:front && npm run build:admin && npm run build:kiosk
